## Remaining doubts

- 49: Γoγ̇aγčin eke-ji as object of sonosqu-jin / üžekü-jin tula (read as 'for the sake of hearing Mother Qo'aqchin … seeing her'); the alternative is an address.
- 69-70: who speaks 'ečige-jin čaγ-un anda keġeldügsen / ečige metü bijü-že keġen' (Temüjin's words as in §96, or Wang Qan quoting himself); now given as 'you said' and hedged.
- 80: ile; read as ile- 'send' (Ming 救去 does not say so); 'the younger brother Jamuqa' has no pronoun in the Mongol.
- 31: žirin-i 'the two' (presumably Qo'aqchin and Börte); 33: who 'they' are at the start of §102.
- 1: the optative -su with keġen read as 'intending to'; 11 aiši and 10 kirγara endings unnamed.
- 5: horubaru-da 'half-dark' (Ming 尙昏時) rests on the context and §98.
- 34-35: umubu / čadqulaṅ / moγai-(j)a; 53: bolžiγ̇uldaba 'was spared'.
- Names: Teṅgeli brook against the published Tünggelig stream; the name-spelling rules for i (ġ→g, ž→j, γ̇→') remain as recorded in QUESTIONS.md.
